correctness.rationale: Exact Brownian half-line and exterior-sphere no-reset survival is strictly concave in radius at every positive time. Convex order reverses single-cycle survival. Common-uniform cycle quantiles together with identical iid renewal deadlines and a fixed common initial hit give a rigorous pathwise first-passage-time ordering, even when a free sphere hit may be infinite. Positive success probability guarantees almost-sure completion; strict Jensen/chord inequalities give unique endpoint/mean-reset extrema. The finite checker passed 332 supporting assertions, including non-Poisson deterministic-clock quadratures; it is not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural fixed-material-zone/fixed-mean-distance search design question is fully classified for the entire completion-time law, not just its mean, and is robust to every independent positive renewal-timer distribution. The point-mass and endpoint-mixture laws are unique worst/best and every intermediate convex-order comparison transfers to all nondecreasing finite costs. The 3D exterior sphere case has a defective unreset first-hitting law, yet the same optimality and almost-sure completion survive, a meaningful nontrivial geometric extension. No downstream application or experimental claim is assumed.
